convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iHigh, iLow, iHighest, iLowest, iATR). Simple breakout entry/exit with channel-based trailing stop. Risk-percent position sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic (Trade.mqh is standard). Single-timeframe logic with pending stop orders.

derived_values.name: exit_long - Long SL price level
derived_values.formula: EXIT_MIDDLE_LINE ? max(Middle(EXIT_PERIOD, EXIT_SHIFT), LowestLow(EXIT_PERIOD, EXIT_SHIFT)) : LowestLow(EXIT_PERIOD, EXIT_SHIFT)

derived_values.name: exit_short - Short SL price level
derived_values.formula: EXIT_MIDDLE_LINE ? min(Middle(EXIT_PERIOD, EXIT_SHIFT), HighestHigh(EXIT_PERIOD, EXIT_SHIFT)) : HighestHigh(EXIT_PERIOD, EXIT_SHIFT)

params.long_sl: exit_long (channel low or middle, whichever is higher)
params.short_sl: exit_short (channel high or middle, whichever is lower)

params.trail_method: channel_based - trails SL to LowestLow/Middle for longs, HighestHigh/Middle for shorts
params.trail_minimum_move: 0.1 * ATR(20) above current SL to ratchet
params.stops_level_check: true - ensures trail - current_price >= SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL before modifying

other_exits: Position close (not just SL move) when price crosses trailing stop level: BUY closed when current_price < trail_long, SELL closed when current_price > trail_short
All pending orders deleted every bar via OrderManaging()

params.calculation_method: OrderCalcProfit to determine loss per 1 lot at SL distance, then lots = risk_money / |loss|, floored to lot_step
params.margin_check: OrderCalcMargin to verify free margin; reduces lot size if insufficient free margin

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If free_margin < 0, lots = 0 (no trade). If free_margin < required_margin, lots scaled down by free_margin/margin ratio, then floored.

custom_logic_notes: This is a Donchian-style breakout strategy. Entry uses HighestHigh/LowestLow channel breakout with BuyStop/SellStop pending orders placed one tick beyond the channel. Exit uses the opposite channel boundary (or middle line if EXIT_MIDDLE_LINE=true) as a trailing stop. Every new bar: (1) all old pending orders are deleted, (2) existing positions are trailed or closed, (3) new pending stop orders are placed if no same-side position exists. The stops_level check ensures pending orders are placed far enough from current price. Lot splitting logic handles cases where calculated lot size exceeds SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX by splitting into multiple orders. ATR(20) is used only for the trailing stop minimum ratchet threshold (0.1*ATR) - not for entry/exit distance calculation. The CalculateLotSize function assumes a BUY direction for profit calculation even when sizing SELL orders (uses ORDER_TYPE_BUY in OrderCalcProfit/OrderCalcMargin).
python_conversion_notes: 1) Entry logic: place BuyStop above HighestHigh channel and SellStop below LowestLow channel - straightforward to replicate with conditional stop orders. 2) Trailing stop is indicator-based (channel midpoint or boundary), not a fixed-pip trail - must track channel values each bar and update SL accordingly. 3) Position close occurs when price breaches trail level (current_price < trail_long for longs), separate from SL modification. 4) CalculateLotSize uses broker-specific functions (OrderCalcProfit, OrderCalcMargin) - in Python, replicate by computing pip_value * sl_distance to get per-lot loss, then lots = risk_money / per_lot_loss. 5) Pending order deletion every bar must be replicated to avoid stale orders. 6) Lot splitting for max_volume constraint needs to be handled. 7) ATR handle is created fresh each call in PositionManaging - should cache the handle in Python. 8) The ENTRY_SHIFT=1 and EXIT_SHIFT=1 mean the EA uses the previous completed bar's channel values, not the current forming bar - this is correct for backtesting. 9) No _Digits/_Point adjustment needed as the EA works in absolute price levels, not pip offsets.
